exposure: Caring for a child with a disability
outcome: Mothers' mental health (depression, anxiety, sleeping disorder)
cohort: The study included mothers from the Norwegian administrative register who gave birth to children between 2009 and 2015.
finding: Mothers caring for a child with a disability have higher odds of having a diagnosis of a musculoskeletal disorder, depression, anxiety, or sleeping disorder than mothers of children without a disability, even after controlling for maternal health prior to birth and socio-demographic characteristics.
followup_time: Up to 10 years after birth (children born between 2009 and 2015 were followed until 2019)
